ages: 0–5 years inclusive; family activities with evidenced suitability
query: with nearby as (select id,category,public_visible,6371*2*asin(sqrt(power(sin(radians(latitude-51.508924)/2),2)+cos(radians(51.508924))*cos(radians(latitude))*power(sin(radians(longitude+0.275866)/2),2))) as km from venues where latitude between 51.40 and 51.61 and longitude between -0.44 and -0.11) select n.category,count(distinct n.id) as venues,count(distinct n.id) filter(where n.public_visible) as visible_venues,count(e.id) as stored_listings,count(e.id) filter(where e.listing_type='activity') as stored_activities from nearby n left join collected_events e on e.venue_id=n.id where n.km<=10 group by n.category order by n.category
